question.prompt: The sum of the numerical coefficients of all the terms in the expansion of \((x-2y)^{18}\) is:

solutions.explanation:
When \(x=y=1\), every variable factor in an expanded term becomes \(1\), so each term becomes its signed numerical coefficient. Therefore evaluating the original expression at these values gives the coefficient sum:
\[
(1-2)^{18}=(-1)^{18}=1.
\]
The sum is \(\boxed{1}\), choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
solutions.title: Set both variables equal to 1
Apply the binomial theorem at 1 and -2
